_comment: Merge this into ~/.claude.json under the top-level "mcpServers" key on the new Mac. The ${HELM_*} vars are injected by Helm per spawned session; this server shows 'failed to connect' when claude runs OUTSIDE Helm — that is expected. The url port (47421) MUST match ~/Helm/config/settings.yaml mcp.port, and the Bearer token resolves from HELM_MCP_TOKEN which Helm sets to settings.yaml mcp.authToken.
